B-NOTIF-6 (agent 115) — growth-project-mobile#341 @ 7c791bb39979eb16481ce71a85de652b41368a3a

New PR, stacked on #312 (contains #312's head f8375ca6; merge #312 first). This PR's own commits: dd7ef271 (tests), 7c791bb3 (code). Tier T3; details and copy in the body.

| Item | Change | Commit | Test (fails on f8375ca6, [one-job lane run](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37142439049): 27 failed / 51 passed) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Device zone with provenance | `PUT /notifications/timezone { timezone, source: 'device' }` on sign-in and foreground; 404/405 → preferences PATCH; 400 not cached, no fallback | 7c791bb3 | timezoneSync: "sign-in sends PUT /notifications/timezone (source device), not the preferences PATCH", "a backend without the route (404 or 405) gets the preferences PATCH, and the zone is cached", "a zone the backend rejects (400) is not cached and does not fall back", "a foreground resume uses the same route" |
| Booking tap opens the session | Client `CalendarSession` → upcoming sessions (session outlined, scrolled once; "no longer scheduled" line); coach `CoachBookingInbox` → booking inbox | 7c791bb3 | pushTapRouter: "client CalendarSession opens upcoming sessions with the session id", "coach CoachBookingInbox opens the booking inbox with the session id"; ClientUpcomingSessionsFocus: "outlines the session the push named", "says plainly when that session is no longer scheduled"; ClientUpcomingSessionsScreen: focusFor cases |
| Settings screen vs live backend (nested body rejected with 400; flat row without `quietHours`) | `preferencesFromBackend` / `preferencesToBackend`; only kinds with a backend switch; PATCH carries only the change; failed save restores and says so; fixed quiet hours row, nothing sent | 7c791bb3 | notificationPreferencesMapping (7 cases); notificationCenter: "renders the kinds that have a backend switch, and only those", "states the fixed quiet hours, with no switch or time pickers", "a channel switch sends only that kind and channel", "a failed save puts the switch back and says the change did not save", mute-all sends `{ muteAll: true }` only |

Pre-push checklist: no free text, email or token in any log; the load effect ignores a result after unmount; the zone stamp is per account and zone (a second account always syncs its own row); copy has no "we/us/our", no exclamation marks, no generic error, no emoji.

Required checks at 7c791bb3: Typecheck, lint, test ([run](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37142603966/job/111259959779)) pass; Analyze (javascript-typescript) and Analyze (actions) ([run](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37142603970)) pass.

Lenses: AUD-OPUS-MOB-CORE, AUD-SOL-MOB.

READY FOR AUDIT

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#341 @ 7c791bb39979eb16481ce71a85de652b41368a3a — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

Independent first audit of the **own stacked delta** from #312 `f8375ca66bf11b2cbb721619c90ab10ff885090e`: all 14 files, both test/code commits, the live backend contracts and the acceptance evidence. **A/B/C 0/2/2.** T3 in the body; apply T4 scrutiny to the newly accepted account-scoped delivery-preference writes and their session/state boundaries. The inherited #312 approval is not a new full review of that parent. ([Candidate/readiness](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/341#issuecomment-5972002872), [stacked parent verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/312#issuecomment-5971998176))

### B-341-1 — unordered live saves let an older full-row reply erase a later successful change on screen

`NotificationPreferencesScreen.tsx:209-225` sends the new one-column patch but publishes the **whole** returned preferences row, or rolls back the **whole** previous row, without admission or ordering. The visible switches remain enabled while `isSaving` is true. This PR changes the live nested/invalid request into an accepted flat patch, so the write path now needs correct completion ownership. ([Save path](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/7c791bb39979eb16481ce71a85de652b41368a3a/src/screens/notifications/NotificationPreferencesScreen.tsx#L209-L245), [live mapping](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/7c791bb39979eb16481ce71a85de652b41368a3a/src/services/notificationsApi.ts))

**Executed actual-screen counterexample:** toggle Direct messages/Push off, hold its reply; toggle Milestones/Push off; complete the second save with both switches off; then deliver the first save's earlier full-row snapshot. Milestones visibly returns **on**, although the later write succeeded. The probe uses ordinary rendered switch events, not a captured stale callback, and the positive intermediate assertion proves the second accepted change appeared before being overwritten. The same whole-row rollback can discard another accepted change. ([One-job probe: 3 failed / 17 inherited controls passed](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37143660900/job/111263109665), [test-only branch](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/tree/audit/AUD-SOL-MOB/341-preferences-admission))

**Minimal fix rule:** serialize accepted preference mutations with synchronous admission, or give completions per-operation/per-key ownership and reconcile a fresh authoritative row after the writes; do not publish stale full rows or restore an entire earlier snapshot over later accepted changes. Preserve every setting and normal saves. Check mounted/current account/session ownership before publishing after awaits. Add the held cross-category response-order regression plus failed-first/later-success and normal-save controls; show failing-before and passing-after CI. ([Affected state boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/7c791bb39979eb16481ce71a85de652b41368a3a/src/screens/notifications/NotificationPreferencesScreen.tsx#L209-L245))

### B-341-2 — the new save failure treats every response as a connection problem and claims an unknown write did not happen

The new `SAVE_FAILED_COPY` at `:180`, catch at `:219-222`, and notice at `:291-299` use one string for every error: “That change did not save. Check your connection and try again.” A known 401/session refusal needs sign-in recovery, not a connection instruction; an unknown 500 can be an unconfirmed write, not proof of no change. Neither branch supplies the unknown-error reference, a working support path or bounded unexpected-error reporting. The actual mounted-screen probes fail separately for 401 `SESSION_EXPIRED` and 500 `UNRECOGNIZED`; the received string is exactly that new generic notice. ([New notice/catch](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/7c791bb39979eb16481ce71a85de652b41368a3a/src/screens/notifications/NotificationPreferencesScreen.tsx#L180-L225), [executed error probes](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37143660900/job/111263109665))

**Minimal fix rule:** classify by status and stable machine code, reuse the parent's bounded preference-error/support patterns where appropriate, distinguish offline/session/rate-limit/known refusal, and give unknown outcomes uncertainty wording, a short reference, a working support action and safe unexpected-error reporting. Reconcile the saved row rather than presenting a previous optimistic snapshot as confirmed server truth after an ambiguous failure. Keep the plain voice and real retry/sign-in functionality. Add actual-screen known/unknown cases and passing ordinary-save controls. ([Existing parent scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/312#issuecomment-5971998176), [affected catch](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/7c791bb39979eb16481ce71a85de652b41368a3a/src/screens/notifications/NotificationPreferencesScreen.tsx#L209-L225))

### Optional C findings

- **C-341-3 — outside this diff's unchanged description:** `:285` promises email continues while muted, but the new mapping sends backend `muted: true`, whose global mute returns before **all** channel gates, and digest eligibility also excludes muted accounts. Update the description to the real all-channel contract; do not change the backend's delivery semantics to fit the old text. ([Description](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/7c791bb39979eb16481ce71a85de652b41368a3a/src/screens/notifications/NotificationPreferencesScreen.tsx#L281-L289), [backend global gate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/0d33c4d4adfb1819f0007a5efbc101c3d8362414/src/notifications/notifications.service.ts#L299-L306), [digest gate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/0d33c4d4adfb1819f0007a5efbc101c3d8362414/src/notifications/digest.service.ts#L372-L396))
- **C-341-4 — absence from a bounded/cached list is not cancellation:** `focusFor` tests absence from the 50-row query's scheduled subset, then `:156` states “That session is no longer scheduled.” An active session outside that slice or not yet in the cached list produces the same claim. Prefer a targeted session lookup before that definitive statement, or truthful “not in this list” copy with refresh. Keep booking-tap routing/focus. ([Bounded query and predicate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/7c791bb39979eb16481ce71a85de652b41368a3a/src/screens/client/ClientUpcomingSessionsScreen.tsx#L55-L94), [new statement](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/7c791bb39979eb16481ce71a85de652b41368a3a/src/screens/client/ClientUpcomingSessionsScreen.tsx#L151-L157))

### Verified / integration

The timezone PUT/provenance, narrow 404/405 fallback and rejected-zone no-cache path match the intended contract; push routes remain allow-listed, role-fenced and string-bounded. The flat preference column mapping, mapped-kind filter and fixed quiet-hours presentation are functional in the passing controls. Exact-head required checks are 3/3 green; full candidate execution is **447 suites / 6,201 passing tests**, but omits the above three counterexamples. Merge #312 first; backend #647/#648 deployment and native push/scroll acceptance remain operator gates, not claims made by this Jest audit. ([Acceptance/rollout contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/341#issuecomment-5972002872), [exact-head CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37142603966/job/111259959779), [independent controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37143660900/job/111263109665))

No local heavy work, candidate-branch edits, merge or production action. One test-only audit branch was executed in the one-job GitHub CI lane.

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#341 @ 7c791bb39979eb16481ce71a85de652b41368a3a — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

This is a T3 audit, accepted from the tier header: no auth, billing, health or deletion. Scope is the PR's own commits, `f8375ca..7c791bb` (`dd7ef27` tests, `7c791bb` feature). The #312 commits it stacks on are audited on #312. **A0 / B1 / C1.**

### What I checked and found correct
- **`timezoneSync.ts`.**
  - It sends `PUT /notifications/timezone { timezone, source: 'device' }`.
  - It falls back to `PATCH /notifications/preferences { timezone }` only on 404 or 405.
  - A 400 is not cached.
  - The `<account>|<zone>` stamp is kept.
- **`notificationsApi.ts` mapping.** The flat columns match backend main `src/notifications/notifications.dto.ts`: `muted`, `message_*`, `milestone_*`, `missed_checkin_*` and `build_week_*`. Unmapped kinds and quiet hours are never sent.
- **`pushTapRouter`.**
  - `CalendarSession` opens `ClientUpcomingSessions`, and `CoachBookingInbox` opens the coach booking inbox.
  - Params pass through the bounded `decodePushParams`.
  - `focusFor` shows "no longer scheduled" only after the list has loaded, because the loading and error states return early.
- **Head checks** are all success.

### B-341-1: concurrent preference saves leave a delivery switch showing the opposite of what the server stored
- **Where.** In `src/screens/notifications/NotificationPreferencesScreen.tsx:210-221`, `save` captures `previous = prefs` from its closure. On failure it restores that whole snapshot (`:221`), and on success it adopts whichever response arrives (`:218`). Nothing serialises or sequences saves, and the switches are not disabled while `isSaving`.
- **Why it is new now.** This PR makes these writes live for the first time; every save used to be a 400.
- **Counterexample (code trace).**
  1. The user turns Message push off (save 1, previous = P0), then Milestone push off (save 2, previous = P1).
  2. Save 2 succeeds. Save 1 fails, or times out after the server applied it, and its rejection arrives last.
  3. `setPrefs(P0)` then shows Milestone push on while the server has it off. The notice says only that "That change did not save".
- **Second interleaving.** Both saves succeed but save 1's response (the row after save 1 only) arrives after save 2's, so `setPrefs(row1)` shows Milestone on again.
- **Prior art.** The sister screen `src/screens/settings/NotificationPreferencesScreen.tsx` closed exactly this class as B-312-2: a latest-state ref, one write at a time and rollback from the latest state.
- **Fix rule.**
  - Allow one write at a time: queue the saves, or ignore or disable toggles while one is pending.
  - Roll back only the failed patch's fields against the latest state (functional update or a ref).
  - Adopt a server row only from the latest issued save.
  - Add failing-before tests with held responses in both orders, plus fail-then-success.

### C-341-2 (outside the changed lines): a load failure renders a blank screen
- **Where.** `:200` `.catch(() => undefined)` followed by `:255` `if (!prefs) return null;`.
- **Effect.** Offline, or a 5xx on `GET /notifications/preferences`, renders nothing: no header, no back control, no cause and no action.
- **Fix rule.** Show a specific failure state with Try again and the reference, keeping the header.

No push to the PR branch, merge, dispatch or production action by this auditor.
